382.title: MS-08: The Dragonsmoot — ✅ Attended
382.content: Status: Resolved (spawned new quests) . The party was diverted to Sylvania, met Vessa (a young copper dragon), and removed Rat’s shadow mark en route. At the Dragonsmoot, IO arrived and triggered Una’s Dracogenesis, completed via the Breath of Becoming (Oman’s fire + Kereska’s magic). IO declared his purpose — remake the World Serpent — and discovered that Essyliss is missing and Null’s Amulet is gone. Tiamat detected the shadow mark on Rat’s severed leg and IO intervened. IO tasked the party with bringing Essyliss to the Outlands, and was about to speak of Null when Thoth teleported the party to the Feywild. Spawned: Find Essyliss (MS-09); the open question of Null (MS-05); what Bahamut and Tiamat want with Una.

383.title: ⌛ MS-09: Find Essyliss
383.content: Status: Active — IO’s direct task . Objective: Find Essyliss and bring her to the Outlands so IO can remake the World Serpent. The World Serpent has nine members; eight attended the Dragonsmoot. Essyliss is the binding force — without her the nine can coexist but cannot cohere. Steven was her prophet and carried the Everscale for years; his bond may be the key. Thoth cannot reach her by any divine means. Why isn’t she answering? . ✅ FOUND — and she said yes. Word reached Steven that Sienna had been sighted, and he went straight there. Sienna is Essyliss. They had it out, and then they mended it. Quietly, and in both directions, in a room with Sofia lying a few feet away. Nobody won it and nobody gave in. Both of them wrote new tenets. Steven’s is “I am forgiven” — the only one of his ten that requires another person to agree, and she agreed to it. The vegetarian tenet stays broken forever; this is how he gets back to ten. Hers is “I will not give up” — the exact reversal of what she walked in believing. ✅ And she gave the Everscale back. All nine of his surviving tenets are live again for the first time since he handed it over. Then she told him the thing she had been carrying: that the fight against Ghroth is hopeless. She had gone and looked at Mappo No Ryujin herself, and it had very nearly killed her, and she had drawn her conclusion. Steven told her about Innominandum. Six people. And he was in the room. She changed her mind. She agreed to help him — and to try to do something for Sofia. Still open: IO’s task was to bring her to the Outlands, and she has not gone yet. She has also seen Mappo with her own eyes, which nobody else alive has. And the Sofia question has moved: Steven found her and Eldath arguing over Sofia’s bed — a forced wildshape is their working idea, mind-restoration uncertain — and the party gets the vote. No verdict yet. How it started — the lead at LIMA. When Eldath brought Sofia to LIMA HQ, Steven and Rat went to sit with her. Steven saw an elf in white across the room, and she left the instant she saw him. He gave chase and lost her, then asked around his own organization and came away with a name.

384.title: MS-05: The Null Problem
384.content: Status: ⛔ The amulet is with Tiamat now . In the First Run, Rat brought the Amulet of Null to the mortal plane; Null was freed, rampaged, and killed gods at the Edge — handing Ghroth’s forces the advantage. In the Second Run, Rat sent Carxi to retrieve the amulet and deliver it (plus Mordenkainen’s future spellbook) to Mordenkainen in Avernus, who was using it to open a pathway to the Null Realm as an escape plan. At the Dragonsmoot, IO realized the amulet was gone — and declared to the assembly that he means to free Null so the World Serpent can be remade, before Thoth teleported the party away mid-sentence. Every dragon there heard the rest. The party did not. ⛔ The handover: the party surrendered the amulet — the real one — to Tiamat, recovered off the counterfeit corpse in Limbo as part of the con. Mordenkainen’s Null Realm pathway is over. Null’s prison now rides with the sister who helped seal him, on the errand of the father who has publicly promised to open it. Where she takes it, nobody knows — and the party is the only faction alive that has watched an unsealed Null end a war.

385.title: MS-07: Save the Feywild & Shadowfell
385.content: Status: ✅ Feywild saved. ⏱ Shadowfell: ~30 hours remaining — the circles are dead, but the west is reachable (Mordenkainen can carry them; the Amulet can gamble them), and the party is at war on the wrong plane. Long ago Thoril, Marvin, and Callahan slew Orcus, and the killing weakened the bonds between the Material Plane, Feywild, and Shadowfell; Marvin and Callahan sealed their souls to prop up the mirror planes. Innominandum came to drain the Feywild through Marvin’s Seal. Tenebrosum is doing the same to Callahan. ✅ Innominandum is dead. All six roots severed; it dropped onto the seal, raised a titan out of the beauty it had stolen, and was driven off anyway. It fled to the Far Realm and the party followed on Primordial Shadow fragments. It tore the governor out of its own engine to detonate the realm rather than lose — Asfache spotted the tendrils still trailing off the controls, R4 declined to evacuate with the Amulet of the Planes in hand, and the whole party took hold and became the governor together. Innominandum materialized inside its own works and Smolder and Rat killed it there. The first of Ghroth’s three Lieutenants. Marvin’s seal finished at full strength — because R4 paid for it. He poured seventy years of his Farylse time into the dome during the fight. That is why the Feywild recovers whole, why Aquandria pledged the entire fey host unconditionally, and why Marvin got a lucid goodbye before settling permanently into the seal. Thoril resealed with half of what remained of his life. A grey circle two hundred feet across is all that’s left where Innominandum rooted — the fey call it The Silence. What it cost: Sofia, used as the Lieutenants’ relay and pulled out too late to save who she was. Horus and Nubia, spent to keep the party standing — only Bast remains. Half of Thoril, with the other half already owed to Callahan’s door. ⏱ The clock. The instant Innominandum died, Tenebrosum doubled its feeding rate. Pentad-Nine — the Mechanus modron that came back with the party — had been holding the Lieutenants’ schedule the whole time and gave the number the moment someone finally asked: seventy-one hours until Callahan is consumed. Twelve went to a long rest in Wip, spent on purpose; roughly eleven more to a day in Wip that got away from everyone; and roughly eighteen to a funeral, a handover, and a declaration of war. Roughly thirty remain. Tenebrosum, known — all of it from Sofia: it waits at the Sunless Lake in the deep Shadowfell, a dry lakebed where light has never reached. She said it looked like a tree, like the thing standing over her, but with bark of shadow. She said it is inside Callahan — not touching his seal, inside him, in through his mouth — and that he has been screaming for months. She was almost gone by the time she said it. The way in is through Albion, on Mystica, where the mad Queen of Albion — the crowned woman from Farylse — guards the portal and does not remember why. Where everyone is: Thoth, Kratos, and Freya have returned to the Edge of Existence and will come when Thoril calls them. Eldath carried Sofia to LIMA. ⛔ Thoril did not stay on Mystica. Cat got a message through to Rat: Thoril has already crossed into the Shadowfell, alone, at half of what he was, not answering anyone. He can feel his friend dying and he has decided he is not going to be too late twice. The gods are still waiting for a call only he can make, and nobody can reach him to make sure he makes it. ⛔ And the circle network is gone. Alamil cannot be found. Ragar examined the teleport circle and found it had been tampered with since it was made — it will not put them where it says, and he cannot say where it will put them. He told them he cannot fix it. The west itself is not sealed — Mordenkainen can teleport the party, and the Amulet of the Planes can gamble them there — but the reliable doors, and any hope of moving armies through them, died with the network. ⛔ Mordenkainen looked too, and named the destination: Avernus. All of them. A trap, built for this party. He can fix it, he says — in about a year, without Alamil’s help. Against this clock, that is the same word — but the door west now has a price on it instead of a no, and the price is a missing portal mage.

386.title: MS-07b: Mechanus Surrendered
386.content: Status: New — brought back from the Far Realm . Innominandum’s engine was clockwork — precise, lawful, scheduled machinery of a kind the Far Realm cannot make. Chaos cannot keep an appointment, and the three Lieutenants have been keeping one. Pentad-Nine answered every question put to it, completely, and without appearing to notice that any of it was bad news: Mechanus ran the pattern on Ghroth, concluded the end is inevitable, and did what a plane of pure law does with the inevitable — it stopped resisting and began administering it. Primus accepted a proof submitted from outside the plane, and Mechanus opened a conduit feeding lawful order into the Far Realm. Modrons walk into it in an orderly queue because they were told to and the instruction was lawful. P-9 was one of them. P-9 no longer accepts the proof. It watched six creatures that are not deterministic take hold of the governor and choose the limit, together, with an exit available and declined. Its conclusion: the event occurred, therefore it was possible, therefore the model that excluded it is incomplete, therefore the proof is incomplete. It calls that arithmetic, not opinion. It is attached to the party until it can find someone with the standing to hear it. Warnings it volunteered: it reports — a property, not a threat — and the party may wish to consider which of their truths they say in front of it. It will close a breach even if a person is the breach. It does not regard either statement as a problem.

395.title: ✅ MS-02j: Feywild — the biggest alliance win of the Second Run
395.content: The Feywild was saved whole — not diminished, not scarred (see MS-07). Aquandria pledged the entire fey host to the Edge of Existence: every court, every wild thing that still knows her name, without conditions. “You will not have to ask twice.” .

396.title: ✅ MS-02k: Beastlands — the debt was paid, by Rat
396.content: The Cat Lord gathered Beastlands forces, animal lords, and the Mortai, and asked Sofia to return in the Fall. The party was diverted to Sylvania and Sofia missed the deadline — and by the time the summons came she could no longer give the apology herself. Felina the Panther walked into LIMA looking for her. Rat showed her Sofia, then offered to go in her place. They took the offer. He stood in front of the Cat Lord and the assembled Mortai for hours while they told him exactly what had been done to them, gave them an apology of sorts, and then took the retribution part of the rite, which nearly took him apart. He came back standing. ✅ And now they have said it: the beasts are committed to the Edge of Existence. Whether the Mortai join them, the grey witness that attends Rat will determine — and the Cat Lord gave Rat a bell to ring when the time comes to battle at the Edge. And something came back with him: a senior Mortai — eight feet of slow grey weather with a face somewhere inside it — now attends Rat everywhere, watching and reporting to its seniors among the Mortai (the Cat Lord’s help is already pledged; the reports go to the ones still deciding). During the con he stayed in the Beastlands rather than bring it near the fraud, and spent those hours showing it what he values: respect, honesty, honor. It looked impressed. Whatever that is worth, nobody has said either.

397.title: ⚠️ MS-02q: The Ent Army — decaying
397.content: Sofia grew the travel-tree network, tended it, awakened it, and was bonded to every tree in it. Without her the trees are going wrong: bark off-color, sap running blue, the awakened ones silent and unanswering. What is failing is the thing that was going to move armies to the Edge of Existence. Nobody knows whether the network can be handed to someone else. ⛔ And it is no longer the only transport problem — Alamil’s teleport circles have since turned out to be sabotaged, and Alamil is missing.

398.title: ⛔ MS-02r: The Broken Circle & the Missing Portal Mage
398.content: Cat sent word from Mystica that somebody had been running tests on the teleport network. Alamil could not be found — his room empty, nothing disturbed. Ragar examined the circle and found it tampered with since it was made: it will not put them where it says, and he cannot fix it. Mordenkainen has since named the destination: Avernus — all of them — a trap built for this party — and put a price on the repair: about a year of his work, without Alamil’s help. Still unanswered: where Alamil is, who took him, and whether the missing man and the wrong door are the same question. Either way, Alamil is now worth a teleport network.

399.title: ✅ MS-02s: Mont Kiara Answered — the Contract Lands Tomorrow
399.content: The six messages came for Smolder — one per personality, each contradicting the other five — and the party went up the mountain. They found the University under attack by devils and demons, held by students and teachers Ralf has embedded his mind into, fighting in perfect unison. And they heard the deal from Ralf himself: Caspian has offered each of his six personalities a body of its own. The contract arrives tomorrow. Some Ralfs want it desperately; some would rather die as one than live as six. Ralf armed the party with La Bombas for their answer. Still unknown: who sent the demons, and what happened to Ulaxium. Meiko’s egg was still safe when the party left.

400.title: ✅ MS-02t: Tiamat Came, Took, and Left — Believing Rat Dead
400.content: She landed on The Rock — the building with the last Ley Crystal in it — demanding the Amulet of Null and asking for Rat by name, ⭐ and told the party herself that IO sent her (and sent Bahamut after Essyliss). Una promised, for the party, to hunt Rat down and recover the amulet — and named Sylvania as the meeting place — and she left the Ley Crystal. Then they kept the promise to the letter and staged everything around it: Mordenkainen built a counterfeit Rat, the marked leg went onto it so her own tracking would swear to the corpse, and the “thief” died in Limbo, crushed by a rock while fleeing his pursuers, the amulet among his effects. She inspected the scene, took the amulet, told Una “I’ll be keeping an eye on you,” and left. Tiamat believes Rat is dead — and dragons at large never knew his face. Six could recognize him, and four of them (Oman, Meiko, Vessa, Bahamut) would never tell her. The live risks: Tiamat seeing him herself, and IO — if the truth ever serves him.

401.title: ✅ MS-02l: Underdark Diplomacy — watch the Underqueen
401.content: Smolder politicked through Menzoberranzan and Zirnakaynin, gained the protégé Ligma Jyzzlazzra, and engineered the assassination of Matron Mother Neerae Kil’urden and her family — securing the Underdark under Underqueen Sinidil Barrirae. The Drow will fight alongside the party. Ligma now runs the post-assassination cleanup (a PR campaign + survivor hunt) on Smolder’s behalf. Sinidil is reliable for now.

402.title: ⌛ MS-02m: Sphinx Alliance (Kemet)
402.content: All four sphinxes were gathered in Farylse; the party solved their riddles and forged the alliance during the Mystica campaign. The sphinxes are tied up fighting the shadow-creature invasion and will join once it’s resolved.

403.title: MS-02n: Triton Alliance (Pirate Isle)
403.content: The party holds Captain Jhodos Rumoxath’s Star-Shell Pendant — present it to his younger self at Pirate Isle to rally the tritons. (Beware aboleths.) (Footnote: the Amulet of the Planes literally dropped Una, R4, and Steven on Pirate Isle mid-mishap during the con. Nobody knocked. The pendant stayed in the pack.) .

404.title: MS-02o: Palanquin Alliance
404.content: The party holds General Gloom’s Captain’s Seal and letter — present them to his younger self to rally the City of the Palanquin and its neighbors.

405.title: MS-02p: The Numbered & the Land of Gears
405.content: The Unnumbered of the Land of Gears wield force weapons made from gaia. Find the spear-wielding Unnumbered and defeat the betrayer-King to forge the alliance.

407.title: Steven — The Fallen Prophet, Essyliss’s Seeker
407.content: Patron: Essyliss. Leads LIMA; holds the writ to silence the Siren Song. Broke his vegetarian tenet under Ghroth’s “Craving” and surrendered the Everscale to a dying Essyliss, losing his boons. At the Dragonsmoot he learned Essyliss is a World Serpent member and defended her publicly — and is now tasked with finding her. In the Far Realm he found that his Siren Song teeth got stronger there: the one part of him she punished is the part that place feeds. At LIMA, an elf in white left the room the instant she saw him. He chased, lost her, asked around, and got a name — Sienna. ✅ She is Essyliss. He found her, they made it up, and his new tenth tenet is “I am forgiven” — the only one of the ten somebody else has to agree to. Hers is “I will not give up.” She gave the Everscale back, so all nine of his surviving tenets are live again. She told him the war was already lost; he told her about Innominandum; she changed her mind. He then served as third hand on the con of Tiamat — Sylvania, the handover in Limbo — and checked on Sofia to find Essyliss and Eldath arguing over how to heal her: their working idea is a forced wildshape, with no promise it restores her mind, and Steven owes the party that conversation. He is now mid-assault on Zariel’s flagship, while Bahamut still searches the planes for the goddess folding blankets at LIMA.

408.title: Rat — Thoth’s Champion
408.content: Patron: Thoth. Carries the Doshenkana poison and Bloodthirst (vorpal longsword); holds HIS Tower. The shadow dragon mark was removed by amputating and regenerating his leg — but the severed, still-marked leg rides in his bag of holding, and Tiamat noticed it at the Dragonsmoot. Caspian’s scrying network still watches him. In the Far Realm he crossed as a mortal rogue with Thoth unable to hear him; he and Una flew into Innominandum and pulled Sofia out, and he and Smolder killed Innominandum inside its own engine. He has been sitting with Sofia at LIMA ever since — listening to a woman talk constantly in something that is not a language, with a god-given gift for understanding any language that is. Then he took her punishment for her. When Felina came with the Beastlands summons, Rat offered to stand in Sofia’s place, and did — hours of admonishment from the Cat Lord and the Mortai, an imperfect apology, and the retribution part of the rite, which nearly took him apart. And then Tiamat landed on The Rock asking where he was. Now he is officially dead. The party staged his death in Limbo and paid Tiamat with the amulet off a counterfeit corpse — while Rat, by his own judgment, stayed in the Beastlands, because the Mortai witness that attends him reports everything it sees to its seniors among the Mortai. He spent the con being sincere at a cloud. It looked impressed. He is dead to dragonkind — six dragons could recognize him, and four (Oman, Meiko, Vessa, Bahamut) would keep the secret; the faces to avoid are Tiamat’s, and IO’s if the truth ever becomes useful to him. He rejoined the party once Tiamat was gone and is on the assault in Avernus — a dead man attending his own war, with the Cat Lord’s bell in his pocket: the beasts are committed, the Mortai ride on the Witness’s judgment, and the bell calls the Beastlands when the Edge does.

409.title: R4 — The Warforged King
409.content: Patron: Aditi (consciousness-sharing). Rules Wip disguised as Emma Wip; convened the Council of United Members; led the Mystica campaign; completed warforged liberation at Gaiadon. Stretched thin across throne, army, and alliances — and must not be unmasked. In the Far Realm, cut off from Aditi and every mind he had ever touched, he spent seventy years of his Farylse time into Marvin’s seal so it would hold whole — and then held the Amulet of the Planes in a collapsing engine and chose not to use it. He also blew up the Catty Shack with a La Bomba because Smolder was annoyed about the competition — and at the Wip council, Luna Cantine told the room it was Far Realm creatures, and nobody contradicted her. Luna Cantine came to him on the morning he was leaving, and left the conversation as intermediary Queen of Wip. He went looking for Alamil and found the road west broken, and took Una through the Amulet of the Planes to the Outlands, where only IO was left standing — and said nothing about where anyone had gone. He then ran the con’s machinery — the corpse commission, the staging, the archmage dispatch — while Una made the promise and the handover; sent Mordenkainen and Carxi to read the circles (verdict: Avernus, a trap — fixable in about a year without Alamil), and is now leading the assault on Zariel’s flagship beside Malachas.

410.title: Bram — The Bard Who Killed a Prince
410.content: Patron: Väinämöinen. Distributed Bram Balls (same-plane teleport). Baz’s reaper hunts him relentlessly — and Bram is the only one who can land the killing blow on Baz (SQ-06).

411.title: Asfache — Champion of Kratos, Seer of the Pool
411.content: Patron: Kratos. United the fire clans, took the Field of Fire. His dreams of the Pool of Memories and the green orb led, in Sylvania, to uniting the doll and orb — the forgotten god gained partial awareness and named the giant robot as its body. Asfache can now see the Pool and watch it shrink; the god cannot show them the way there until he is reunited with his body. He left the orb at the Far Realm threshold and watched Cal dissolve for the second time, then went in anyway — and inside, it was Asfache who spotted the governor tendrils and called everyone onto them. Pentad-Nine rides on his back and answers to him. Back in Wip he spent fifteen years of his own Farylse time aging his griffon Rodney into a full warmount in an afternoon. During the con he stood corpse-duty in Limbo with Smolder — and spotted a githzerai spying on them. He ran the watcher down; the watcher, caught, asked whether he worked for the githyanki or the mind flayers; and the answer — a résumé of dead illithids and one split elder brain — earned a name, Dak’kon, and a request for help. He is now riding Rodney into the assault on Zariel’s flagship.

412.title: Sofia — The Ent Mother ⚰
412.content: Patron: Oakfather & daughters. Built a travel-tree network for army teleportation; was raising an Ent Army. Missed the Cat Lord’s Fall deadline — the Beastlands alliance hangs in the balance (MS-02k). In the Far Realm, Innominandum used her as the relay for its network: the frog sac Ghroth put in her throat during the first run was a receiver. Una and Rat pulled her out. She came out breathing and has not woken since — and until two goddesses started arguing over her bed, everyone believed she never would. Mielikki came to the grove, said nothing, and wept. Eldath asked permission to sit with her weekly, and carried her to LIMA. The Oakfather did not come. What she paid for is most of what the party knows about Tenebrosum and Mappo — including that Mappo cannot leave the Pool, so the party chooses the moment. New: Steven walked in on Essyliss and Eldath arguing over her bed — their working idea is to forcefully wildshape her, with neither goddess sure it would bring her mind back. The party gets the question next. No verdict has been made.

413.title: Una — The Golden Dragon
413.content: Patrons: Freya (aspect), Kereska (guidance). Found her father Oman; allied with Meiko and guards her egg. Completed Dracogenesis at the Dragonsmoot via the Breath of Becoming. Both Bahamut and Tiamat have taken a direct interest in her — what they want remains to be seen. At the Far Realm threshold she set all of it down — consecration, aspect, Etta, her dragonhood — and walked in as something less, then flew into Innominandum with Rat to pull Sofia out. Back in Wip she gave a magic item maker one of her own scales and commissioned a communication device out of it, for Oman, so an audience with her father never ends mid-sentence again. It is still unfinished. She went back to the Outlands with R4 to leave IO a sending stone for Oman and found the field empty: ⛔ only IO was there, and her father was gone. Nobody knows where Oman and Meiko went. She was also beside Steven on the road home when the chromatic flight came in over Wip. In the con it was Una who made the party’s promise to Tiamat on The Rock; she rode the mishap tour (Fortitude in the Outlands, an unnamed mirror dimension with a gangly slender almost-man in it, Pirate Isle), led Tiamat from Sylvania to the staged grave, and delivered exactly what she had promised — and it was Una the dragon queen looked at, over the corpse, before leaving with the amulet: “I’ll be keeping an eye on you.” A dragon god’s standing attention is now hers, and she did not ask for it.

414.title: Smolder — The Underdark Operator
414.content: Patron: Tentative champion of Freya. Smut Shaq empire thriving; “Catman” vigilante. Secured the Drow alliance by assassinating Neerae’s house. His protégé Ligma runs the cleanup. Created an ally, Sinidil, who may become a problem. In the Far Realm he spent Nubia and then Horus to the Junish Sacrifice — both permanently gone, and their strikes with them. Only Bast remains. He and Rat killed Innominandum. His competitor, the Catty Shack, is no longer standing. ✅ And the reply got answered: the six messages came, the party went up Mont Kiara, and the truth turned out to be a contract — see MS-02s. Smolder also stood the long vigil over the fake corpse in Limbo (where they caught Dak’kon spying), and is now on the assault against Zariel’s flagship.

415.title: Ralf — Six Minds in a Metal Body
415.content: Patron: none currently (Vecna, first run only). Freed by Smolder; runs the Arcane University at Mont Kiara — which the party found under attack by devils and demons, defended by students and teachers Ralf has embedded his mind into. The six strange messages were the six personalities arguing about Caspian’s offer: a body for each of them, contract due tomorrow. Some want it desperately; some would rather die as one than live as six. He armed the party with La Bombas for their answer to it.

416.title: Side Quests
416.content: . | ⛔ SQ-01 — The Caspian Threat: OPEN WAR. His hand is now visible in the circle trap (aimed at Avernus, built for this party), the contract on Ralf’s desk, and — the party suspects — the whole week’s timing. Their answer: La Bombas from Ralf, Malachas as an open ally, and a direct assault on Zariel’s old flagship, where Malachas pinpointed him. The ship opened fire. Next session opens mid-battle. | ⛔ SQ-11 — The Assault on Zariel’s Flagship: happening right now — the party plus Mordenkainen and Carxi (he teleported everyone to the war, which makes him the ride home) beside Malachas’s host. Riding on the outcome: the contract due at Mont Kiara tomorrow; answers about Alamil; the scrying orbs; and ~30 hours on the Shadowfell clock. | SQ-12 — Dak’kon’s Request: a githzerai was caught spying on the Limbo vigil. Asfache ran him down; he asked “githyanki, or mind flayers?”; the answer (dead illithids, one split elder brain) turned capture into a request for help. With what, he has not yet said — but he left the party a paper roll: instructions to his githzerai city, written in Deep Speech and Gith. An invitation with an address, in two scripts nobody present reads unaided. | SQ-13 — Stay Dead, Rat: Tiamat believes Rat died in Limbo, and her own tracking swore to it. Six dragons could recognize his face, and four of them (Oman, Meiko, Vessa, Bahamut) would never tell her — the live risks are Tiamat’s own eyes, and IO, if the truth ever serves him. The con was flawless. Keeping it flawless is now a permanent line item. | SQ-02 — The Giant Robot: The forgotten god’s doll now knows its body is the 5-mile clay titan and can lead the party to it once they’re back on the mortal plane. Reunite god and titan; find the Pool of Memories before it’s consumed. | SQ-03 — Eara & the Heart of the Forest: Sofia holds the Heart of the Forest; deliver it to the Circle of Elders on Eara. | SQ-04 — Smut Shaq Enterprises: Franchise thriving in Wip and Jun; income, intel, and morale. Nala and Raja manage locations. The competing Catty Shack was leveled by a La Bomba; market share in Wip is uncontested. | SQ-05 — Sofia’s Ent Army: ⚠️ Decaying. Bark off-color, sap running blue, the awakened trees silent. See MS-02q. | SQ-06 — Baz’s Reaper: Baz hunts Bram through the party’s shadows. Only Bram can permanently destroy him — but Baz only needs to catch him once. | .

417.title: Completed Quests
417.content: . | MS-04 — The Shapeshifter Purge: Boop of Truth deployed continent-wide; shapeshifters cleared from The Rock and the dwarven cities. (Some remain in unreached lands.) | SQ-07 — Warforged Liberation ✅: R4 freed and awakened the inert warforged at the Statue of the Wanderer in Gaiadon, strengthening Aditi. | MS-06 — The Heart Melts Gambit ✅: Heart Melts is dead in both runs. The Orb of Consciousness was destroyed; the igloid army awakened. The Melts family is now an ally of necessity. Cal’s fate is unknown. | SQ-08 — Dryzzlazz’s Cure ✅: Cured in both runs; she served as a Drow-contact diplomat. | SQ-09 — The Wereshark Grotto ✅: A wereshark ritual opened a Far Realm portal; the titan’s last pilot fled to Farylse. Feeds into SQ-02. | SQ-10 — Rat and the Last Leg Casino ✅: Rat took Cat’s ring off Gofor Hindle for nothing, found the skeleton under the Last Leg through the ring’s X-ray sight, blew the casino apart, and rebuilt the real Catroniel’s body with time magic (the “Cat” in Wip was a shapeshifter); he appeared in Thoril’s bar with it and Steven revived him, and he now leads the shadow-creature resistance in Mystica with Junish airships — the same continent Thoril has just walked onto alone. | .

418.title: R4
418.content: Warforged. The Warforged King, Champion of Aditi. R4 (R41F) woke up as a warforged and has been running things ever since. When Emma Wip was murdered during the coup in the city’s early days, R4 stepped into the dead ruler’s place behind a borrowed face — and has ruled Wip in her name ever since, which is a secret that could end him. His patron is Aditi, goddess of consciousness, revered by warforged; her gift is the sharing of minds, and R4 has spent two years building a political machine out of it. Known for. Convening the Council of United Members — the council for the whole home archipelago, Wip’s own being the WANC. Leading the Mystica campaign west, city by city up the Nile. Completing warforged liberation at the Statue of the Wanderer in Gaiadon, freeing and waking the inert warforged there. Leveling the Catty Shack with a La Bomba because Smolder was annoyed about the competition, and then standing in a council room while Luna Cantine told everyone it had been Far Realm creatures. The price nobody has thanked him for. In the Far Realm, cut off from Aditi and from every mind he had ever touched, R4 poured seventy years of his Farylse time into Marvin’s Seal so that it would finish whole. That is why the Feywild recovers, why the fey host came in unconditionally, and why Marvin got a lucid goodbye. Then he stood in a collapsing engine holding the Amulet of the Planes, with an exit in his hand, and chose not to use it. Where he stands now. Luna Cantine came to him on the morning he was leaving and left the conversation as intermediary Queen of Wip. He ran the machinery of the con of Tiamat — the corpse commission, the staging, the archmage dispatch — sent Mordenkainen and Carxi to read the sabotaged teleport circles, and is now leading the assault on Zariel’s flagship beside Malachas.

419.title: Gallery
419.content: R4, wearing Emma Wip’s face — the Queen of Wip — standing over his own sabotaged teleport circle while Ragar reads it.

420.title: Ragar Huntsfellow
420.content: Gnomish arcanist. Advisor to the throne of Wip. The man who reads the thing nobody else can read. Ragar Huntsfellow graduated from the Arcane University at Tamsend and has spent the war since as the arcanist the ruler of Wip sends for. His fingerprints are on most of what the party depends on and almost none of what the party gets credit for. He refined the La Bomba into something that could be built to a standard rather than improvised — and it was Ragar who worked out that a shard of Ley Crystal as the receptacle holds vastly more than any gem ever will, which is the entire reason the weapon scales. He found the cure for Dryzzlazz’s curse. He restored the barrier on the Underwell, what lies sealed beneath The Rock, after the seal was breached. And, years before any of that, he is the one who freed R4 from igloid control — which makes him, in the most literal sense, the reason there is an R4 at all. Then he was handed the circle. With Alamil missing and the road west closed, R4 brought him to the teleport circle in Wip and asked him what was wrong with it. Ragar looked at it for a while and gave the worst possible answer, plainly and without softening it: .

421.title: “It has been tampered with since it was made.”
421.content: Not damaged. Altered. It will not put you where it says it will. He could not say where it would put you, and — the part that landed hardest — he told them he cannot fix it. Where he stands now. In Wip, with a sabotaged network he has already refused to promise anything about, in a city being run by a regent, for a Queen who is off-plane shooting at a rakshasa. The best arcanist the party has on the ground has looked at their biggest logistical problem and said no. That is not a puzzle waiting to be solved by asking him again.

422.title: Ralf
422.content: Wizard. Six personalities, one metal body. President of the Arcane University. Ralf is a wizard with six personalities, which is five more than the situation usually calls for. He died once already — killed by the sabotage of Etheniss Orlytlar, Wip’s drow Spymaster, deep in the Soul of the Rock — and was dragged back by an improvised resurrection built out of an igloid body, a fistful of Ley Crystal shards, and his own hat. He has not been entirely one person since. Known for. La Bomba — the party’s signature explosive, magic missiles packed into a delivery system, crated by the dozen and handed out to allies across two continents. Running the Arcane University at Mont Kiara. Being freed by Smolder, who is, by his own six-part account, his best friend. Where he stands now. Mont Kiara went quiet, and the messages the Wip council kept receiving turned out to be six strange people all asking for “best friend.” The party went up the mountain and found the University under attack by devils and demons, defended by students and teachers Ralf has embedded his own mind into. The six voices were six positions in one argument. Caspian has made him an offer: a body for each of them, contract due tomorrow. Some of him wants it desperately. Some of him would rather die as one than live as six. He armed the party with La Bombas for their answer to it.

423.title: Gallery
423.content: Ralf before: a dwarf, a hammer, and exactly one personality. Then Etheniss’s sabotage killed him in the Soul of the Rock, and what walked back out was an igloid body, a fistful of Ley Crystal shards — and the same hat. Ralf. Six minds, one hat, and the Ley Crystals showing through where his eyes used to be. The same wizard, a different one of him. The table has opinions about which.

424.title: Rat
424.content: Rogue. Master thief, spymaster, Champion of Thoth. Rat (Radtismir) is the party’s thief, and by now something closer to its intelligence service. He runs informants the way other people run businesses, he holds HIS Tower, and he carries the Doshenkana poison and Bloodthirst, a vorpal longsword with opinions. Thoth, god of knowledge, gave him one gift above all others: he understands any language that is spoken. Known for. Taking Catroniel’s ring for nothing off the skeletal arm the Last Leg Casino had nailed up beside its door; finding the skeleton under the casino and blowing it apart over it; rebuilding the real Catroniel’s body with time magic. Stealing the Amulet of Null out of Tiamat’s tomb in the First Run — the single worst decision anyone in the party has ever made, and one he spent the Second Run undoing. Having a shadow dragon’s chromatic mark cut off him along with the leg it was on. Flying into Innominandum with Una to pull Sofia out, and killing the Lieutenant inside its own engine with Smolder. And then he took Sofia’s punishment for her. When the Beastlands summons came, Rat stood in her place: hours of admonishment from the Cat Lord and the Mortai, an apology he could not make perfect, and the retribution that nearly took him apart. He came out of it with the alliance secured and a bell in his pocket — one ring, saved for the Edge of Existence, and it will be answered. Where he stands now. Officially dead. The party staged his death in Limbo and paid Tiamat with the real amulet off a counterfeit corpse, and the dragon queen’s own tracking swore to it. Rat sat the con out and stayed in the Beastlands, because a Mortai Witness now attends him everywhere and reports what it sees. He rejoined the party once Tiamat was gone: still hurt, still dead to dragonkind, and mid-assault on Zariel’s old flagship over Avernus.

425.title: Gallery
425.content: Bloodthirst. A vorpal longsword with opinions, a taste in creature-types, and no interest in being sheathed. Rat, as the dice see him. *“Rat with Malacus?” — a misheard Arch Devil, immortalized.* . *Immune to crit. Two Champions of the gods, receiving the news.* . *“OH MY GAWD!” The master thief, being carried out of somewhere by a cleric.* . Rat and the Witness, in the Beastlands. Nothing in his hands at all.

426.title: Rodney
426.content: Asfache’s griffon. Fifteen years old in an afternoon, and about six months old on the inside. Rodney hatched in the First Run, and Asfache raised and trained him from the shell. Then the timeline reset and put him back in the egg, which is the sort of thing this campaign does without comment. So Asfache did it again — and then, during the interlude in Wip, he did something else. He spent fifteen years of his own Farylse time on the griffon, in one sitting, and stood there while a juvenile became a full warmount. He only grew. That is the important part and it is the sad part. The years went into the body and not into the animal: full size, full strength, a war-beast’s frame — and a fledgling’s heart still living inside it, with no experience of anything at all. The comparison writes itself, and both numbers are already in the record. R4 spent seventy years on a seal that holds a plane shut. Asfache spent fifteen on a pet. Neither of them has apologized for it and neither of them should. Where he stands now. Under Allies on the ledger, in the air over Avernus — flying into the first real barrage of his life, at fifteen years old and roughly six months of actual living.

427.title: Sinidil & Ligma
427.content: The Underqueen of Zirnakaynin and the young noblewoman who keeps her there. Smolder’s largest political win, and his largest exposure. Sinidil Barrirae is the Underqueen of Zirnakaynin, and she is on that throne because Smolder decided she should be. The job he was given by Matron Mother Neerae Kil’urden was to frame Sinidil for plotting to take Llolth’s place. What he did instead was talk his way into Sinidil’s confidence and out again as her advisor — and then arrange the assassination of Neerae and her entire family, which left the Underqueen’s position uncontested and the Kil’urden claim without a claimant. The Drow will fight beside the party at the Edge of Existence because of it. That is an entire people, added to the muster, by a tabaxi entrepreneur who was originally sent down there to run an errand. Ligma Jyzzlazzra — a daughter of Llolth, and Smolder’s protégé out of the same run — handles what comes after a succession like that one. She runs a patient public campaign through drow society legitimizing Sinidil’s rise, and a much less public hunt for anyone who survived the night and remembers it differently. Both halves of the job have the same purpose: keeping the trail clear of Smolder. The quest log’s own verdict is the whole entry: Sinidil is reliable — for now. The ledger files her under It’s Complicated, with Kil’urden loyalists a few lines down under Enemies. Where they stand now. Holding the Underdark, on a throne with a recent history and a very short list of people who know exactly how recent it is.

429.title: Smolder
429.content: Tabaxi. Entrepreneur, Underdark diplomat, tentative champion of Freya. Smolder is a tabaxi with a business empire, a vigilante identity, and a diplomatic portfolio, in roughly that order of personal importance. The Smut Shaq franchise is thriving in Wip and Jun and returns income, intel and morale in equal measure; Nala and Raja, the two leonin who followed the party out of Farylse, manage locations. When he is not doing that he is “Catman.” . Known for. Securing the Drow alliance by assassinating Neerae’s house, and installing his protégé Ligma to run the cleanup. Freeing Ralf. Creating an ally, Sinidil, who may yet become a problem. Answering the six strange messages from Mont Kiara because he is the “best friend” they kept asking for. What it has cost. In the Far Realm he spent Nubia and then Horus to the Junish Sacrifice — both permanently gone, and their strikes with them. Only Bast remains. Where he stands now. He and Rat killed Innominandum inside its own engine. His competitor, the Catty Shack, is no longer standing and his market share in Wip is uncontested. He stood the long vigil over the fake corpse in Limbo — where they caught Dak’kon watching them — and is now on the assault against Zariel’s flagship.

430.title: Gallery
430.content: Catman. A secret identity in the sense that everybody knows and nobody says it out loud. The robe of eyes, worn on the high street like it is nothing. Twenty percent off for the nearsighted, today only. The robe and the sword together. Between them, something is always watching, and something is always hungry. Bloodthirst got what it asked for. Smolder is still working out how he feels about how easy that was. Before the empire, before the Underdark, before the franchise: a monk, a road, and no accounts to keep. Freya’s tentative champion, doing a very convincing impression of someone who meant to end up here. Shrubby. The table has agreed not to discuss Shrubby. Smolder, with hair. The Smut Shaq’s grooming division has range. What the table calls the Hulk. What Smolder calls a productive afternoon in a difficult market. Scale is a matter of perspective, and Smolder’s perspective has always been expensive. Diplomacy, Smolder-style: acquire the assets first, negotiate the terms at leisure. Nala and Raja. The White Lion wanted his severed pieces back. He paid in a fresh writ and these two, who now manage Smut Shaq locations.

431.title: Sofia
431.content: Druid of the Oakfather. The Ent Mother. Retired. Sofia was the party’s druid — a battle druid and a shapeshifter, sworn to the Oakfather and his daughters. She built the travel-tree network the army teleports through, she was raising an Ent Army, and she still holds the Heart of the Forest, which was meant to go to the Circle of Elders on Eara. What happened. She entered Innominandum as an air elemental during the Far Realm phase and could not get out. The Lieutenant used her as the relay for the three Lieutenants’ network — the frog sac Ghroth’s Siren Song planted in her throat during the First Run was the receiver, and the rest of her was the antenna. Una and Rat pulled her free. She came out breathing and was never Sofia again. Her throat is open along its full length and breathes on its own. Her eyes do not close. Her pulse and her breathing run at two different speeds. Sometimes she says things in a language nobody can read, to nobody at all. Nothing has fixed it — not the Oakfather, not restoration, not wishes. What she paid for. Almost everything the party knows about Tenebrosum and Mappo No Ryujin came out of her before she went: the Sunless Lake, the roots in Callahan’s throat, the months of screaming, and the fact that Mappo cannot leave the Pool — which means the party chooses the moment of that fight. Where she stands now. Mielikki came to the grove, said nothing, and wept. Eldath asked permission to sit with her weekly and carried her to LIMA HQ. The Oakfather did not come. Rat has been sitting with her. Now two goddesses argue over her bed. Essyliss and Eldath are proposing a forced wildshape — a new shape, a fresh body — and neither will promise it brings her mind back. The party has not decided.

432.title: Gallery
432.content: *“I’MA DROP THAT WALL!” — the battle druid’s entire tactical doctrine, in four words.* . The wall in question. The brain in question. The green orb came out of one of these. The Oakfather, imparting wisdom. He has not come to the grove since. Sofia and the elder brain. The green orb came out of one of these.

433.title: Steven
433.content: Lizardfolk. Prophet of Essyliss, DwarvoDraco, founder of LIMA. Steven is the prophet of Essyliss, goddess of devotion, and the DwarvoDraco — the chosen one of the lizardfolk. He founded LIMA, his order of Essylissian volunteers, immediately after assassinating the shapeshifter posing as mayor of New Dwarf City, and he holds the writ to silence the Siren Song: the party’s actual win condition, carried in a prophet’s pack. His faith runs on ten tenets and the Everscale, the scale Essyliss gave him, which carries his boons. Under the Craving — the meat-hunger Ghroth’s bite left in him — he broke the vegetarian tenet — permanently — and surrendered the Everscale to a dying Essyliss, losing his boons with it. He spent months as a prophet with vows and no way to speak them. Known for. Taking the New Dwarf City Dwarfway on tour through the lizardfolk tribes (Jersey Dwarfs, Dwarf Lightning, Chicago, The Lizard of the Opera). Raising the writ in the First Run’s last battle and stopping the Siren Song — it worked, and it was not enough. Defending Essyliss publicly at the Dragonsmoot, and learning in the same breath that the goddess he served is a member of the World Serpent. The reconciliation. At LIMA an elf in white left the room the instant she saw him. He gave chase, lost her, asked around his own organization, and came away with a name: Sienna. Sienna is Essyliss. They had it out and then they mended it, quietly and in both directions, in a room with Sofia lying a few feet away. His new tenth tenet is “I am forgiven” — the only one of the ten that requires somebody else to agree, and she agreed to it. Hers is “I will not give up.” She gave the Everscale back. Then she told him the war against Ghroth was already lost, and he told her about Innominandum, and she changed her mind. Where he stands now. He served as third hand on the con of Tiamat, then looked in on Sofia and found two goddesses arguing over her bed. He owes the party that conversation. He is on the assault over Avernus with the rest of them, kit back, and the Shadowfell after that.

434.title: Gallery
434.content: The Prophet of Essyliss. The hat is not, as far as anyone can establish, doctrinal. *Lizard, Laugh, Love. Nine of the ten tenets are spoken. This one he had inked.* . “I need to speak to the mayor.”* **New Dwarf City. The mayor was a shapeshifter, and his remaining tenure was measured in minutes.* . Having removed the incumbent, he did consider the vacancy. LIMA came out of it instead. LIMA on the march. The rank ladder runs Lizard, Alligator, Dragon, Grand Lizard, and the sending stones mean it runs without him. Going up the wall the direct way, as is his custom. *“OH MY GAWD!” A tactical extraction of a thief who had run out of hit points and dignity.* . Farylse. A Chronologian, and Steven’s foot, arriving at the same place at the same time. The afternoon the party learned that Steven has a type. “Your mom is a baddie.”* **Una has not fully recovered.* . Essyliss and her prophet, back when the boons still answered. Devotion, drawn the way devotion is usually drawn. The real version involved an aid-house, a false name, and a very long argument. “Anyway, I’m covered in bones.” There was more to the sentence. Nobody remembers it.

435.title: Magnum Tenebrosum
435.content: Second Lieutenant. In the Shadowfell, at the Sunless Lake. Next. Tenebrosum is doing to the Shadowfell what Innominandum did to the Feywild. Long ago Thoril, Marvin and Callahan slew Orcus, and the killing weakened the bonds between the Material Plane and the two mirror planes; Marvin and Callahan sealed their own souls into the breach to prop them up. Marvin’s seal held. Callahan’s is being eaten. Everything known about it came out of Sofia, and she was almost gone by the time she said it: . | It waits at the Sunless Lake in the deep Shadowfell — a dry lakebed where light has never reached. | She said it looked like a tree, like the thing that was standing over her, but with bark of shadow. | It is inside Callahan. Not touching his seal — inside him, in through his mouth. He has been screaming for months. | . The clock. The instant Innominandum died, Tenebrosum doubled its feeding rate. Pentad-Nine had been holding the Lieutenants’ schedule the whole time and gave the number the moment somebody finally asked: seventy-one hours until Callahan is consumed. Roughly thirty remain. The way in is through Albion, on Mystica, where the mad Queen of Albion guards the portal and does not remember why. The teleport circles west are dead — sabotaged, and aimed at Avernus — so this is a ride, not a door: Mordenkainen can carry the party, and the Amulet of the Planes can gamble them there. Armies cannot follow. And Thoril has already gone in alone, at half of what he was, not answering anyone. The gods at the Edge are still waiting for a call only he can make. Sofia said a tree. This is what was drawn from her telling. Nobody has stood in front of it and come back to correct the picture.

436.title: The Witness
436.content: A senior Mortai. Eight feet of slow grey weather with a face in it. It follows Rat. Rat came back from the Beastlands with company. It is about eight feet of slow grey cloud that does not quite touch the floor, and there is a face somewhere inside it, at some depth, never entirely resolving. It goes everywhere he goes. It watches. It does not speak, does not advise, does not fight, does not vote, and does not leave. It is a senior Mortai, and it does not report to the Cat Lord. It reports to its own seniors among the Mortai — the ones who assembled on Sofia’s word, waited, and were left standing there. It cost the party its master thief for a day. When the plan to defraud a dragon god was laid out, Rat took himself off the job — nobody stages the greatest fraud of their careers in front of the Beastlands’ idea of a court reporter. He stayed behind and spent those hours instead showing the thing respect, honesty and honor.

437.title: Whether weather can be impressed, weather does not say. It looked impressed.
437.content: Why it matters. The Cat Lord said it out loud: the beasts are committed, but whether the Mortai themselves take the field at the Edge of Existence is the Witness’s call. An entire faction of the Beastlands is riding on the opinion of something that has never said a word. Where it stands now. Directly behind Rat, in a warzone over Avernus, in weather that is a degree colder than the air around it.

438.title: Gallery
438.content: The Witness, attending. The face never resolves.

439.title: Thoril
439.content: Killed a demon prince. Kept a bar. Currently spending himself, in halves, to hold two planes shut. Thoril was one of three who slew the demon prince Orcus — with Marvin and Callahan — and that victory is the root of everything that has gone wrong since. Killing Orcus weakened the bonds between the Material Plane, the Feywild and the Shadowfell. Marvin and Callahan each sealed their own soul into one of the mirror planes to hold the walls apart. Thoril did not, and has been paying the difference ever since. The party met him running a bar in a dwarven city under living shadow, with a scarred basilisk coiled around the place. He was holding the Aspects, and his price for the Aspect of Chaos was not gold: tell me a story. They each told him one. Then Smolder booped him with Truth, and “he straightened up like a man remembering an appointment” — and he left to go save his friends. He kept that appointment. After Innominandum died, Thoril communed with Marvin and poured half of his remaining life force into a new seal on the Feywild. It took about ninety seconds and made almost no noise. The plane came back whole, and Marvin’s soul went free. The other half is already owed. In the grove afterwards he said he can feel Callahan breaking — “Not dying. Breaking… the way a man hears something through a wall.” . Thoth, Kratos and Freya are standing at the Edge of Existence waiting for a call that only Thoril can make. There is no other way to bring the gods to the Shadowfell. Where he stands now. Gone into the dark, alone. He did not stop on Mystica and he is not answering. Half of what he was, walking into the plane a Lieutenant is currently eating, ahead of everybody.

440.title: He can feel his friend dying, and he has decided he is not going to be too late twice.

441.title: Gallery
441.content: Marvin’s seal, whole. Ninety seconds, almost no noise, and half a life.

442.title: Thoth
442.content: God of Knowledge. Patron of Rat. Thoth picked a thief. Rat is his Champion — an honorific, not a power — and the one gift the god actually handed over is precise and enormous: Rat understands any language that is spoken. Thoth is a working member of the divine line at the Edge of Existence, and he does not stand on ceremony about it. He reached across the planes mid-sentence at the Dragonsmoot — while a creator god was still talking — and snatched the party straight into the dying Feywild, because the Lieutenant there was already pulling the plane apart and there was no more time to spend on dragons. Where he stands now. Back at the Edge, with Kratos and Freya. All three will come to the Shadowfell the same way they came to the Feywild: when Thoril calls them.

443.title: Gallery
443.content: The table’s contribution to Thoth scholarship. The god of knowledge has declined to comment.

444.title: Tiamat
444.content: Queen of chromatic dragons. One of IO’s two great extensions. Currently holding her brother’s prison. Tiamat is one of the two great extensions of IO — the chromatic half of dragonkind, to Bahamut’s metallic half — and for most of this campaign she has been a rumor with a tomb in Avernus. The party’s first business with her was a theft: in the First Run, Rat took the Amulet of Null out of her horde, and the world paid for it. In the Second Run, Carxi took it out again, earlier and quieter. At the Dragonsmoot she caught the scent of the shadow dragon mark on the severed leg in Rat’s bag and came surging across the field toward the party. IO stepped between them. Then she came in person. She landed on The Rock — the building with the last Ley Crystal in the world inside it — with the chromatic flight wheeling above her, and asked the city two questions: where is the Amulet of Null, and where is Rat. She told the party herself that IO had sent her, and that Bahamut had been sent after Essyliss. Una answered for the party: we will hunt Rat down ourselves, and we will bring you the amulet. Tiamat accepted, named Sylvania as the meeting place, and took her flight away. She was given exactly what she was promised: the amulet, recovered from the effects of a dead thief in Limbo, with the marked leg on the corpse to satisfy her own tracking. Then she looked at Una — the newest gold in the world, the one who had made the promise and kept it to the letter — for slightly too long.

445.title: “I’ll be keeping an eye on you.”
445.content: Where she stands now. Gone, with her brother’s prison in her claws, on the errand of a father who has publicly promised to open it. She believes Rat is dead. The party would very much like her to go on believing that.

446.title: Gallery
446.content: The handover in Limbo. She got exactly what she was promised, and left believing the rest.

447.title: Chronologian Timecops
447.content: Time cops. The rank and file of temporal law. You do not rewind five years of history without somebody noticing. The Chronologians — the party calls them time cops, and so does everyone else — are the guardians of the timeline’s integrity, and they were waiting on the far end of the jump. They came in gold and clockwork, took Freya into custody, and vanished with her. Getting her back cost the party a running fight through one of their strongholds and a deal with the man in charge. They are not, on the evidence, evil. They are law enforcement for a rule the party broke on purpose, working for a steward who let the offenders walk because he saw a use for them.

448.title: Gallery
448.content: Enforcement, arriving. They came for a broken rule, and stayed for the paperwork.

449.title: Ulaxium
449.content: Former President of the Arcane University at Tamsend. Two runs, two disappearances. Ulaxium ran the Arcane University at Tamsend, on Mont Kiara, and was the party’s first point of contact there. Ralf holds the office now. He is a small man in a large hall who has twice now been the first to notice something and the last to be heard from. The First Run. He sent the distress call — something has invaded — and it became one of the three warnings of Year 1 that nobody had the hands to answer. R4 answered it as best he could: he sent Skol Cantine up the mountain with seven La Bombas. Skol went silent. So did the mountain. Seasons later, pixies came back with the answer, and it was one sentence: .

450.title: “The president is dead. Long live the president.”
450.content: Ralf had killed him and taken the school. The Second Run went better, right up until it didn’t. R4 brought Tamsend into the Council of United Members and shared the La Bomba plans with a university representative, and for a long while the arrangement worked. Then Ulaxium stopped responding. In his place the Wip council began receiving letters from six strange people, all of them asking for “best friend.” . The party went up the mountain. They fought through his own halls, past fiends and past the students and teachers carrying Ralf’s mind, and they did not find him. Nobody has said the obvious thing out loud. Where he stands now. Filed under Missing & Unreachable, in a building the party has already searched, in a run where the last time he stopped writing letters it was because somebody else was answering them.

451.title: Una
451.content: Young golden dragon. Dragon liaison, aspect-carrier of Freya. Una is the daughter of Oman, and at the Dragonsmoot she completed Dracogenesis through the Breath of Becoming — forged into a young golden dragon in her father’s flame. She carries an aspect of Freya — a tattoo on her back, where the goddess comes and goes — and a consecration from Kereska, and travels with Etta, a fire falcon. Known for. Finding her father. Allying with the ancient golden dragon Meiko and guarding her egg — it was Una who returned that egg in the First Run, and it is what sealed the dragon alliance. Being the party’s line to dragonkind generally, which is a heavier job than it sounds: both Bahamut and Tiamat have taken a direct personal interest in her, and neither has said what they want. In the Far Realm she set all of it down — consecration, aspect, Etta, her dragonhood — eleven hours after being forged into it, and walked in as something less. Then she flew into Innominandum with Rat and pulled Sofia out. Where she stands now. She gave a magic item maker one of her own scales and commissioned a communication device from it, so that an audience with her father never ends mid-sentence again; it is still unfinished, and it is still the only line to Oman she controls. She went back to the Outlands with R4 to leave IO a sending stone and found the field empty — no dragons, no serpent gods, no Oman. In the con of Tiamat it was Una who made the party’s promise on The Rock, and Una who delivered exactly what she had promised over a staged grave. The dragon queen looked at her before she left with the amulet: “I’ll be keeping an eye on you.” .

452.title: Gallery
452.content: “I let my hair cover my other eye, for drama.” . The scales came in gradually, and then all at once. Dracogenesis. The Breath of Becoming: her father’s fire, Kereska’s magic, and the company that got her there. Una and Oman over the Djermani Hills — the audience she spent a year earning. The Field of Fire at Viavolca Way refused her mortal shape. It had no objection at all to the other one. *“Your mom is a baddie.” Steven, being Steven.* . *Immune to crit. A shared professional disappointment.* .

453.title: Väinämöinen
453.content: Deity of Yore. Patron of Bram. Väinämöinen is a god of the plane of Yore, and Bram found him in Glarsht with a hole where his voice used to be. The White Lion had taken it. That grievance is the reason the party has a war-winning object at all. The map Väinämöinen gave Bram led to the Lion — one of The Artists, beings outside the scope of both gods and the Far Realm — and, by way of the painter Flamencio, who put the party bodily into his own canvases to reach something that lives outside space and time, to the writ to silence the Siren Song. The party pressed the Lion into making the writ, then took it by force and hacked him apart. Artists cannot truly be killed; he turned up again in Farylse, wanting his pieces back, and traded a fresh writ and two leonin followers — Nala and Raja — for them.

454.title: Gallery
454.content: Giving directions. A god with no voice, explaining who took it. Bram got there in the end.

455.title: Vessa
455.content: Young copper dragon, chronicler, and the only person in Sylvania who was going to tell the party the truth about what they were carrying. Vessa is a young adult copper dragon who mostly does not bother being one. She presents as a wiry woman in her late twenties: short copper-streaked hair, a crooked grin, loose traveling clothes with too many pockets, and a satchel covered in enamel pins from places that may not exist. She had been camped in Sylvania for weeks when the party’s failed planar shift dumped them into the middle of the best bar in the Outlands. She was at their table within a minute, because a large group of armed mortals appearing out of nothing is exactly the kind of thing she collects. Her project: a chronicle of the Dragonsmoot — the first in ten thousand years. She had been buying drinks for every traveler passing through and hoarding what they said: rumors, eyewitness accounts, lies, prophecies, indiscriminately. She hoards stories the way a red hoards gold. (The other reason she was still in Sylvania and not in the field: the Dragonsmoot is full of ancients, wyrms and dragon gods, and she is young, and she knows it. “Gathering intel first” is a very good name for nursing a drink.) .

456.title: The receipt
456.content: Then she got within a few feet of Rat, and stopped mid-sentence.

457.title: “That’s not hoard-scent. Hoard-scent fades. This is a ward — chromatic divine energy, baked into your skin. Like a receipt. A very angry receipt.”
457.content: She did not panic and she did not run. She explained, in order, exactly what it meant: that every dragon within a hundred feet of the Dragonsmoot would know something was wrong with him, that the chromatics would be curious and the metallics hostile, and that there is only one being whose guardians carry all five chromatic signatures. Her price was the truth. Copper dragons can smell a lie and do not tell them; what she wanted in exchange for everything she knew was the party’s real story, told properly, so she could decide whether walking beside them would get her killed. Her condition was that the mark came off before they went anywhere near that field. It came off. She is the reason. Where she stands now. Last seen at the Dragonsmoot, presumably still writing it all down. Vessa is one of six dragons who could pick Rat out of a crowd. She is also one of the four who would keep their mouths shut about it.

458.title: The White Lion
458.content: The Lion Who Shakes the Spear. An Artist. Dismembered once, and not remotely finished. The White Lion — the Lion Who Shakes the Spear — is one of The Artists: beings outside the scope of the gods and outside the scope of the Far Realm. He writes things, and then they are true. The party came to him because he had stolen Väinämöinen’s voice, and a god with a grievance is a very good map. They reached him through Flamencio’s paintings, since the Lion lives nowhere that has an address, and they pressed him into composing the one thing in existence that answers the Siren Song — a writ that silences it. Then they took it by force during an earthquake and hacked him apart, which is the single most party-shaped thing that has ever happened in this campaign. It did not take. Artists cannot be conventionally destroyed. He turned up again in Farylse, wanting his pieces back — and the pieces were still in the party’s bags of holding, because of course they were. The trade was clean: his body parts, for a fresh writ and two leonin followers, Nala and Raja. Where he stands now. On the ledger under It’s Complicated, which is generous of the ledger. The party has the writ that wins the last fight of the war, and they got it from a being they murdered and then did business with.
